references.label: River plunge lane
references.description: The hidden river path is reached by a controlled plunge.

references.label: Center spinner
references.description: The center spinner is the safer bailout and one King Kong Jackpot collect.

references.label: Gong bash target
references.description: The gong qualifies Premium and LE scenes, adds scene time, and advances major features.

references.label: Kong Cave scoop
references.description: The left-center cave is the Pterodactyl collect and a King Kong green award.

references.label: Giant Spider Pit
references.description: The Pit magnet shot qualifies and collects Pit Multiball jackpots.

references.label: Lost Temple drop bank
references.description: The four drops qualify King Kong locks and expose the hidden Treasure target.

references.label: King Kong lock ramp
references.description: The center ramp collects King Kong locks and relocks balls for its later phase.

references.label: Biplane side ramp
references.description: The side ramp starts Biplane Attack and collects King Kong Super Jackpots.
